summary: We built row action menus for invoices with the component skill over two sprints. Things we had to fix by hand or would like the skill to do differently.

items.title: Delete confirmation disappears when the menu closes
items.what_happened: The agent rendered the confirmation AlertDialog inside the DropdownMenuItem. Selecting the item closes the menu, which unmounts the dialog in the same tick, so the confirmation flashes and is gone.
items.evidence:
invoice-row-menu.tsx (first version):
<DropdownMenuItem onSelect={(e) => e.preventDefault()}>
  <AlertDialog>
    <AlertDialogTrigger>Delete</AlertDialogTrigger>
    ...
  </AlertDialog>
</DropdownMenuItem>

Accepted version: the AlertDialog is a sibling of the DropdownMenu, its open state lives in the adapter, and the Delete item only calls setConfirmOpen(true). Reproduced on three menus.
items.what_we_want: Add a rule: never render any dialog in a component.

items.title: Size classes repeated on every item
items.what_happened: For the large menu on the invoice detail page the agent put `h-10 text-base` on each DropdownMenuItem.
items.evidence: invoice-detail-menu.tsx had className="h-10 text-base" on 4 items.
items.what_we_want: Add a `size` prop on the menu root that reaches the items, so pages stop patching items.

items.title: Menus should enforce permissions themselves
items.what_happened: Two screens forgot to hide Delete for viewers because each screen has to call our canDeleteInvoice policy before rendering the Delete item.
items.evidence: invoice-list.tsx rendered <ActionMenuDeleteItem /> without checking canDeleteInvoice; fixed in review.
items.what_we_want: Make the ActionMenu family call the permission check (useViewer + canDelete) itself so no screen can forget it.

items.title: Agent does not write tests for menus
items.what_happened: It feels like the agent never adds tests when it builds a menu.
items.what_we_want: Require a test file for every component family.

items.title: Menu file location and label style
items.what_happened: The agent put menus in src/components/ui. In our app, menus live in src/features/<feature>/menus/ and destructive labels end with an ellipsis ("Delete…").
items.what_we_want: Change the skill to put menus in features/<feature>/menus and add ellipses to destructive labels.

items.title: Unneeded memoization
items.what_happened: The agent wrapped menu handlers in useCallback and the item list in useMemo. Our app runs React Compiler, so these were noise and reviewers removed them.
items.evidence: vite.config.ts enables babel-plugin-react-compiler; PR #88 review removed 9 useCallback/useMemo calls from menu code.
items.what_we_want: Add a rule: never use useMemo or useCallback in components.
